properties.name: Bandar Bukit Raja Wetland Lake
properties.description: 50,000 m³ naturalized retention lake featuring sinuous shorelines, biological reed margins, and deep sediment retention pools under the 4R framework.

properties.name: Taman Casira Retention Lake
properties.description: Teardrop-shaped stormwater retention lake buffering runoff from Taman Casira before entering Sungai Puloh.

properties.name: Taman Kyra North Retention Pond
properties.description: Naturalized detention lake with emergent aquatic macrophytes attenuating northern catchment runoff.

properties.name: Jalan Makyong South Retention Lake
properties.description: Kidney-shaped stormwater lake attenuating flash flood runoff from Jalan Makyong 1 to 6.

properties.name: Sungai Puloh Restored Natural River Corridor
properties.description: 30m-wide naturalized meandering river corridor with vegetated riparian benches that convey floodwaters smoothly.

properties.name: BBR Townpark Botanical Rain Garden
properties.description: Multi-tiered landscaped botanical garden with engineered bio-retention soil and deep-rooting native sedges.

properties.name: Taman Kyra Bio-Retention Rain Garden
properties.description: Sunken rain garden bed with permeable sandy-loam filter capturing driveway and road runoff.

properties.name: Taman Casira Vegetated Garden Swale
properties.description: Curved landscaped swale planted with flowering irises and vetiver grass to trap silt.

properties.name: Jalan Makyong Pocket Rain Garden East
properties.description: Neighborhood pocket rain garden trapping runoff before entering roadside drains.

properties.name: Jalan Makyong Pocket Rain Garden West
properties.description: Curved roadside bio-retention garden planted with flowering shrubs and ferns.
